Subject: PebbleWorks — SOC 2 packet & next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Jake / Lina,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. As promised, attaching the SOC 2 packet we walked through and a short controls summary to make review easier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations: 

- What we covered: Redwood runtime isolation, key management options (KMS/HSM), audit log retention, and data-at-rest encryption.
- Packet attached: Redwood_SOC2_packet_PebbleWorks_20270420.pdf (SOC 2 report + artifacts) and SOC2-Controls-Summary.xlsx (controls mapping).

Action items / owners:
- Jake: Confirm whether your compliance team needs a vendor questionnaire completed (ETA: 4/27)
- Lina: Share any specific data residency or retention constraints (ETA: 4/27)
- Ben (me): Share a short controls overview doc and set up 30-min controls walkthrough with our security lead if helpful.

If it helps, we can schedule a dedicated 30-minute call where our Head of Security walks through the packet with your compliance lead. Happy to make that calendar invite once you confirm a few times that work.

Thanks — I’ll follow up next week if I don’t hear back.

Best,

Hi Jake / Lina —

Marissa here (Ben’s manager). I wanted to briefly check in — Ben mentioned we hadn’t seen confirmation from your compliance team yet about the packet. I know these reviews can get deprioritized; happy to help remove friction. A couple of options that have worked for other customers: 

- Schedule a 30-minute controls walkthrough with Hannah (CC) and our security team — we can tailor it to your questionnaire.
- We can fill in your vendor security questionnaire directly and return a redline within 3 business days (if you can share the doc).
- If there are timeline concerns, we can prioritize a short extract of the controls evidence you need most (e.g., encryption, RBAC, audit logs).

If helpful, I can escalate this internally to get evidence extracted faster. Would you prefer we schedule the walkthrough or start by completing your questionnaire? If neither, please tell us if the review is on hold so we stop sending unnecessary nudges.

Appreciate the update —
Marissa Cole
